description: See how much of your Claude and ChatGPT (Codex) usage limits is left, right in the status bar. Unofficial; not affiliated with Anthropic or OpenAI.
config.title: AI Usage
config.refreshIntervalSeconds: How often to check usage, in seconds. Results are shared across open VS Code windows within this interval.
config.showClaude: Show Claude usage in the status bar.
config.showChatGPT: Show ChatGPT (Codex) usage in the status bar.
config.codexPath: Path to the codex executable. Leave empty to search PATH and common install locations (Homebrew, pnpm, npm, etc.).
